note: Tome Static Cron generates the Tome Static site incrementally on cron using a queue worker. Its only configuration is the config object tome_static_cron.settings with a single required key, base_url (validated as a URL by the settings form at /admin/config/services/tome_static_cron/settings, permission 'use tome static'). If base_url is empty, hook_cron does nothing. It queues uncached paths into the 'tome_static_cron' queue and TomeStaticQueueWorker renders them on later cron runs. It adds no Drush command. Medium reads the configured base_url; hard sets a valid base_url. Both are pure-config operations (no rendering), so they are safe and reliable on the shared host. The reset/cleanup delete the config object, restoring the shipped baseline where no base_url is set.

evals.prompt: After enabling the tome_static_cron module, what must you configure for cron to actually generate static HTML, and at which admin path?
evals.expected_output: Set the Base URL (config key base_url in tome_static_cron.settings) at /admin/config/services/tome_static_cron/settings. If base_url is empty, hook_cron does nothing.

evals.prompt: How does tome_static_cron generate the static site differently from running 'drush tome:static'? Mention the queue it uses.
evals.expected_output: On each cron run it enqueues uncached paths into the 'tome_static_cron' queue and a TomeStaticQueueWorker renders them across subsequent cron runs (incremental, one cycle at a time), instead of a single blocking 'drush tome:static' build. Already-cached paths are skipped.

evals.prompt: Does tome_static_cron add its own Drush command, and what triggers a cron static build?
evals.expected_output: No, it adds no Drush command. Builds are triggered by Drupal cron (system cron or 'drush cron') via hook_cron(), provided base_url is set.

evals.prompt: This site already has Tome Static Cron configured. Inspect the live configuration and report the Base URL it will use for cron static generation.
evals.expected_output: https://static.example.org — stored at tome_static_cron.settings:base_url (read with 'drush cget tome_static_cron.settings base_url').

evals.prompt: Enable cron-driven static generation on this site by configuring Tome Static Cron with a valid Base URL (use https://cron-build.example.com). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set tome_static_cron.settings:base_url to a valid absolute URL (e.g. https://cron-build.example.com) via the settings form or 'drush cset tome_static_cron.settings base_url https://cron-build.example.com -y'. Verify passes when base_url is a non-empty valid URL.
